blocks.heading: What is TSM10?
blocks.body: GHRH analog profile associated with visceral-fat and GH-axis research. Coze describes Tesamorelin as a synthetic 44-amino-acid GHRH analog that stimulates endogenous GH release, raises IGF-1 markers, and is approved for reducing visceral adipose tissue in HIV-associated lipodystrophy. Tesamorelin 10mg is mapped to LPPeptide SKU TSM10. Current storefront values use our product data: 10mg x 10 vials /box, $169.00 USD per box. LPPeptide reference specs: 5mg x 10 vials / 10mg x 10 vials.

blocks.heading: Research context
blocks.body: Coze describes Tesamorelin as a synthetic 44-amino-acid GHRH analog that stimulates endogenous GH release, raises IGF-1 markers, and is approved for reducing visceral adipose tissue in HIV-associated lipodystrophy.
